entries.f00600cff2d4e8c7: It sets "promotion of a new sales strategy" and "expansion of production capacity" as priority issues. On the sales side, it says it will promote sales expansion of high-value-added blowers, vacuum pumps and repairs, and work on expanding sales of large blowers with special specifications based on technical capabilities cultivated through long experience, and on providing solutions suited to customers' usage processes. On the production side, it says it will advance the sophistication of production planning to shorten production lead times, the renovation of large processing equipment and multi-skilled workers, and proceed systematically with the completion of a new machining building in 2027 and a new assembly building in 2028. As its vision, it also says it aims to be a company with No.1 customer trust as a vacuum pump professional.
